name: stickman
label: Stickman
pitch: Black-ink stick figure on cream paper with a vignette (ThatGuy / Productive Peter style): second-person self-improvement storytelling, numbered points, close-ups for emotion.
title_examples: 7 Habits That Secretly Make You Look Weak
Stop Doing This If You Want People To Respect You
Why You Can't Stay Disciplined (And The Fix)

image.prefix: Classic stickman-animation YouTube style in exactly the same art style as the reference image: bold black ink line art on clean cream off-white paper, thick uniform strokes for the character and the background, simple clean sets with minimal detail (no cross-hatching, no fine texture, no gradients), flat evenly lit paper with no vignette, no dark corners and no shadows at the edges, monochrome black-and-white, no color.
image.character: When the main character appears he is EXACTLY the stick figure from the reference image: a perfect circle head, two small black dot eyes, a simple one-line mouth and small eyebrow lines for emotion, thin stick limbs. {outfit}. Other people are stick figures in the same style.
image.composition: 16:9 landscape composition. One clear moment, big readable subject, simple line-art set (room, street, office) only when the scene needs it.
image.text_none: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, or words anywhere in the image.
image.text_some: The only text allowed in the image is: {text} — spelled exactly like that in simple black hand lettering. No other text.
